name: Chroma icon
description: Rainbow-cycles your icon colors, glow, trails and fire. Pick exactly what is affected in the settings.

show-rainbow-palette.name: Rainbow palette color on
show-rainbow-palette.description: Adds a Rainbow swatch to the icon kit color grid (slot 111). Pick it for Color 1, Color 2 or Glow and it cycles through the rainbow in your game. Turn off to disable everything.

rainbow-id.name: Rainbow palette slot number
rainbow-id.description: A NEW slot that is not one of the normal palette colors. Everyone with the mod must use the same number. Pick a normal color again before removing the mod.

upload-slot.name: Send the Rainbow slot to other mod users
upload-slot.description: OFF (recommended): other players see the nearest normal palette color to the rainbow, which every game understands. ON: your profile is uploaded with the Rainbow slot instead, so players with the mod see a moving rainbow, but players without it see an unknown color. Your real saved colors are never changed.

speed.name: Speed (cycles per second)
speed.description: How fast the rainbow cycles. 0.3 is about one full loop every 3 seconds.

color-1-offset.name: Color 1 hue offset
color-1-offset.description: 0 = Color 1 matches Color 2. 0.5 = opposite side of the rainbow.

title-effects.name: Effects (when my icon uses the rainbow)

regular-trail.name: Trail
regular-trail.description: Only tints the trail's color. Your selected trail design is never touched.

ship-streak.name: Ship trail
ship-streak.description: Only tints the trail's color. Your selected trail design is never touched.

ship-fire.name: Ship and UFO fire / click particles
